quiz.question: Which processing model provides the lowest latency for real-time analytics?
options: Batch processing with periodic scheduled jobs
quiz.explanation: Stream processors (e.g. Flink) aggregate events continuously as they arrive instead of waiting for a batch window.

quiz.question: Why redirect the user to the advertiser through our own click endpoint?
options: So every click is recorded before the redirect
quiz.explanation: A server-side redirect guarantees the click is captured — client-side tracking can be blocked or lost.

quiz.question: What does a periodic batch reconciliation job protect against?
options: Inaccuracies in the real-time stream aggregates
quiz.explanation: Re-computing from raw events catches anything the streaming path dropped or double-counted, since clicks are billed.

quiz.question: How do you prevent the same user's click from being counted twice?
options: Deduplicate using a unique impression/click ID
quiz.explanation: Tagging each ad impression with a unique ID lets the system drop repeated clicks for the same impression.
